properties.description: rectangular (D2h-like, bond-alternating) closed-shell singlet ground-state minimum of cyclobutadiene; the isolated molecule is the pre-reaction 'complex' for this unimolecular automerization (gas phase, no solvent, no counterion)
properties.evidence_note: rect_min_start.xyz is the MMFF seed; the optimised minimum is the converged structure of rect_min_start.out (also saved as rect_min_opt.xyz).

properties.description: square D4h structure: first-order saddle of the antisymmetric (b1g-type) bond-alternation coordinate; all four C-C = 1.4305 A, planar
properties.caveat: the restricted (closed-shell) GFN2-xTB solution at the square geometry is essentially degenerate (HOMO-LUMO gap 1.6e-6 eV), so the square is a diradicaloid that a single-reference semiempirical SCF describes poorly; the imaginary frequency (-4612 cm-1) and the barrier are therefore not quantitative
properties.evidence_note: square_collapse_control_xtb.xyz is the D4h-symmetrised square start; the optimiser converged on the square (final structure saved as xtbopt.xyz at the time of job 984, energy -10.408998459544 Ha).

properties.description: rectangular minimum reached downhill from TS1 along the imaginary mode: same rectangular geometry but with the bond alternation exchanged (1-2 and 3-4 now long/single, 2-3 and 4-1 short/double); simply the automerized reactant
properties.evidence_note: endpoint_fromTS_A_xtb.xyz is the displaced-square START of this run (labelled a=1.44, x=-0.05); the optimised endpoint geometry is the converged structure of endpoint_fromTS_A_xtb.out (0 imaginary frequencies, E = -10.444857381340 Ha).

edges.channel: concerted single-step skeletal automerization through the square D4h first-order saddle

properties.reference_minimum: RC (rectangular singlet minimum, E = -10.444857330164 Ha, 0 imaginary frequencies)
properties.transition_state: TS1 (square D4h, E = -10.408998459544 Ha, 1 imaginary frequency at -4612.29 cm-1)
properties.barrier_definition: delta-E double dagger = E(TS1) - E(RC), GFN2-xTB electronic energies, no ZPE or thermal correction
properties.connection_evidence: downhill displacement along the imaginary mode followed by re-optimisation gives two rectangular minima (endpoint_fromTS_A/B_xtb.out) with exchanged bond alternation and energies degenerate to 1.4e-10 Ha; rigid D4h ring-family single points sqgrid_a*_x*.out show the square is a maximum in the alternation coordinate
properties.caveat: restricted closed-shell GFN2-xTB at the square is electronically degenerate (HOMO-LUMO gap 1.6e-6 eV); the value is the GFN2-xTB result only and is not transferable
